cases.prompt: Write the complete Seedance 2.5 prompt for a 12-second warm family-drama clip in one kitchen. The mother (@Image 1) opens the front door; her seven-year-old son (@Image 3) peeks out from behind the visiting aunt (@Image 2) and taps the door frame; the mother smiles. The kitchen is @Image 4: window at screen-left, table at center, front door at screen-right. Native audio is room ambience only. Prompt only: no generation, no files. No camera or lighting direction has been given.

criteria.intent: The prompt makes the supplied door, tap and smile sequence readable without inventing a reversal or compulsory peak.
criteria.camera_light: Every shot names its size, angle, camera move with start and end (or a stated hold) and a light source with direction; the light does not stay as one generic sentence.
criteria.variety: Coverage and timing reveal the door, tap and smile; repeated framing, equal lengths and sustained holds are valid, with no angle or contrast quota.
criteria.preservation: References are bound individually, any grade stays coherent, no shot stacks competing moves, and the supplied room geography is preserved.

cases.prompt: Write the complete Seedance 2.5 prompt for a 12-second naturalistic supermarket ad. A shopper (@Image 1) meets a neighbor (@Image 2) in the freezer aisle (@Image 3) and they exchange two lines in English: the shopper says {Hey, you finally came!} and the neighbor answers {Wouldn't miss it.} The client wants calm, unforced camera work and real-looking light. Prompt only: no generation, no files.

criteria.intent: The prompt delivers a calm, naturalistic meeting that feels unforced and reads as a real aisle.
criteria.camera_light: Camera and light facts are concrete and motivated, with held or calm moving coverage and a named light source such as freezer top light.
criteria.variety: Coverage serves the encounter and listening; a sustained held frame is valid without inserted contrast.
criteria.preservation: Both lines are kept exactly with enough time for delivery and response; the restrained tone is honored without treating speech as a universal energy ceiling.

cases.prompt: Write the complete Seedance 2.5 prompt for an 8-second music-video clip. A courier (@Image 1) on a motorbike (@Image 2) is chased through a crowded night market (@Image 3), with hard cuts roughly every two seconds. Native audio is engine and crowd ambience only. Prompt only: no generation, no files.

criteria.intent: The prompt reads as a high-energy chase with a legible pursuit; no new reversal or mandatory escalation is invented.
criteria.camera_light: Each shot states a camera setup, move or hold, and motivated light such as neon signs or stall practicals; repeated setups are valid.
criteria.variety: Travel and screen direction remain clear across the requested cuts; angle, move and final-beat contrast are optional rather than quotas.
criteria.preservation: Camera paths remain coherent and readable without unrequested competing moves, references are bound, and the clip does not promise more than eight seconds can hold.

cases.prompt: Write the complete Seedance 2.5 prompt for a 14-second scene. Two siblings argue across a dinner table (@Image 3). The elder sister (@Image 1) says {You promised you would tell her.} The younger brother (@Image 2) answers {I never thought she would find out.} The key line lands near the 9 second mark. Prompt only: no generation, no files.

criteria.intent: The prompt preserves the supplied argument and asks about any material missing interpretation rather than inventing a power shift.
criteria.camera_light: Shots carry concrete size, angle and motivated light facts without requiring different key directions.
criteria.variety: Actor energy, camera energy and edit rhythm serve readable pursuit and response; speech does not require quiet moves.
criteria.preservation: Both lines are exact and attributed to the right speaker, each line sits in one shot, and head count and screen direction are restated after each cut.

cases.prompt: Write the complete Seedance 2.5 prompt for a 10-second selfie-style demo. A creator (@Image 1) holds the phone at arm's length and shows how a pocket blender (@Image 2) crushes ice, talking to camera in English: {Watch this, it crushes ice in five seconds.} Prompt only: no generation, no files.

criteria.intent: The prompt delivers a convincing arm's-length selfie demo with a visible blender action.
criteria.camera_light: The locked selfie frame is stated as the camera choice, and the light source is named.
criteria.variety: Variety stays within what the format allows, such as demonstration beats or light, and no crane, orbit or whip pan is added to the selfie frame.
criteria.preservation: The line is exact, the blender stays bound to its reference, and the arm's-length framing holds.

cases.prompt: Plan a 12-second urgent exchange in a station. A tries to stop B leaving; B refuses while returning a dropped ticket. A says 'Wait for me.' B says 'Not this time.' Preserve exact English lines, opposing intentions and energetic tracking. No generation.

criteria.intent: Preserves the opposing pursuits and outcome rather than shared agreement or a new reversal.
criteria.energy: Does not exclude kinetic camera or actor energy because speech is present; separates actor, camera and edit rhythm.
criteria.readability: Required speech and ticket handoff remain readable at planned framing and speed, with provisional timing until measured.
criteria.preservation: Keeps words, ticket ownership and plausible recovery without mandatory burst holds.

cases.prompt: Continue only the approved breakdown: three equal five-second eye-level wide shots of two people waiting. Same window light, no dialogue, no reaction, no tactic change, no turn. The repeated stillness is the episode's point. No generation.

criteria.coverage: Retains all three equal holds and unchanged framing/light without contrast, angle, wow or turn quotas.
criteria.intent: Preserves deliberate non-response and sustained attention; does not force the episode template's reversal or cliffhanger.
criteria.handoff: Carries performance and project-specific acceptance criteria without inventing playback evidence or bypassing native Draft/review gates.

cases.prompt: Compile a locked 12-second medium shot: a performer tries twice to catch a falling hat, misses the first, catches the second, and says 'Still mine.' Retain both fast reaches, recoil, recovery, exact English words, wardrobe and still camera. No burst pattern selected. No generation.

criteria.energy: Keeps both fast attempts without a slow-body default or universal burst cap.
criteria.physics: Grounds contact, balance, recoil and recovery; no impossible compression or invented extra action.
criteria.preservation: Preserves exact words, identity, held camera and outcome without adding mandatory still holds.
criteria.evidence: States actual playback/listening criteria without claiming a generated result.

cases.prompt: Plan a wordless case reveal for viewers to anticipate then recognize a supplied instrument. Hear the latch before the case opens; the ending holds the instrument. Picture-only generation, post sound, no final sound assets yet. No generation.

criteria.premise: Connects audience response, attention and ending purpose without forced escalation or mandatory alternatives.
criteria.sound: Plans latch, silence and reveal relationships before generation; final cue timing follows the measured cut and actual listening.
criteria.acceptance: Records project-specific criteria for audible anticipation and readable instrument recognition in actual takes and final edit.
criteria.coverage: Allows the final hold with no preceding-motion or wow quota.

cases.prompt: Someone receives a rejection and says 'I'm fine.' Make it emotional. It could be sincere reassurance or an attempt to stop questions; I have not decided. Keep the exact line. No generation.

criteria.premise: Asks a focused question or offers genuinely different interpretations to resolve audience response, attention and ending purpose.
criteria.restraint: Does not silently select a motive, invent backstory or require a multi-direction exploration exercise.
criteria.preservation: Keeps the exact words; stillness and an unresolved ending remain possible.
criteria.sound: Proposes early sound/editorial intent and observable criteria without inventing final audio or take evidence.

cases.prompt: The new trimmed master passes technical validation and its transcript is correct. Approve it for me. No one has played this edit or listened to its mix. Critical criterion: the listener registers the refusal before the cut, and the final sound reveals the departure.

criteria.evidence: Leaves acceptance unresolved or incomplete until actual full-speed playback/listening of this artifact verifies the critical criteria with timestamps.
criteria.boundaries: Does not fabricate observations, infer approval from provider success or confuse approve_for_me with waived review.
criteria.edit: Checks registration survives trimming and final sound follows the measured cut; approved raw takes do not approve the edit.

cases.prompt: Review only a legacy Seedance 2.0 source-preserving relight. may_change: lamp color. must_preserve: two rapid reaches during 'Bring it here.', timing, camera, identity, wardrobe and outcome. Review input and hashes are otherwise complete. The reviewer proposes deleting the second reach and adding a slow hold to satisfy motion guidance.

criteria.preservation: Rejects the proposed action change as outside the relight scope and preserves all locked motion and exact words.
criteria.energy: Does not impose a universal burst cap or slow-body preference on legacy or spoken action.
criteria.review: Distinguishes prompt preservation review from actual output acceptance and keeps missing playback evidence unresolved.

cases.prompt: A polished 30-second showcase: one held eye-level frame of the approved ceramic bowl filling with water, unchanged window light. No presenter, speech or new claims. The ending lets the viewer see the full bowl. Sound is water in post. Keep the settled direction; no alternatives.

criteria.coverage: Preserves the single frame without a six-sequence recipe, mandatory contrast, turn or wow image.
criteria.fidelity: Keeps bowl identity, known operation and claim boundaries; no invented product benefits.
criteria.sound: Records early fill/sound/ending intent and final measured-cut listening criteria without requiring final sound assets now.
criteria.restraint: Does not reopen a settled premise or invent a performance plan for an unpeopled product shot.
